messages:
marta: Okay team, tiny SOS  my playoff RB just got listed as "questionable" after warmups. Anybody got a last-minute plug or a handcuff that actually sees snaps? :pray: 

diego: Who is it?

marta: D. Price. He rolled his ankle in warmups. My semifinals are Sunday. 

sam: Yikes. I can offer my depth RB (T. Owens) for a straight swap if you can spare a WR. Has decent PPR floor.

marta: My WRs are M. Carter, B. Cho, and K. Nunez. Would do Carter for Owens? He's been steady.

diego: Also reminder: office pool draft sheet is pinned in #random-pools. If you're bringing snacks to Saturday watch, drop emoji next to your name. :popcorn:

marta: @sam that trade would save me. Sending now.

commish-bot: Trade submitted: marta -> sam : M. Carter for T. Owens. Status: PENDING APPROVAL. Reason: outside trade window.

kelly: I'll approve if everyone else signs off. Also can confirm Owens has been getting 8-12 snaps last 2 games, so should be OK.

sam: Approved from me. Go ahead @kelly.

kelly: Approved. Commish-bot, finalize please.

commish-bot: Trade executed at 1725564378. Note: please update your lineup before lock.

marta: THANK YOU :heart_eyes: Filing this under "office heroes." Snacks are on me Sunday.

diego: Solid teamwork. Also, tiny poll: wings or pizza for watch party? React with :chicken: or :pizza:.

sam: :pizza: (i tried to be helpful and chose the better option) :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

kelly: :chicken: gotta rep my local spot.

marta: Both are acceptable. More importantly, my RB actually looks like he'll play. Fingers crossed. :crossed_fingers:
